name: e32-soak-r1
reason: On the workstation the 30-minute soak on final-r2 fails because the store's durable barrier stalls for up to 640 ms on a deduplicating volume. The VM host stores on ext4 over virtio. This run answers whether the unchanged soak passes when the volume is different.
players_note: The workstation's frontier, kept so the two soaks carry the same workload. This host is faster, so it is a lighter load here.
cpu_layout: servers on CPUs 0-3, bots on CPU 4, harness and system slices on CPUs 5-7
fixture_unchanged: same logs beside the store's journal on one volume, proxy fallback at its defaults, same direct-bot routing, store --sync full
pass_line: crossings every minute, zero duplicated cargo, zero owner violations, no production process growing 10 percent or more from minute 5 to 30

comparison_readback.store_barriers: count, p50, p99, p99.9, maximum, and the count over 50, 100, 200 and 400 ms
comparison_readback.renewal_replies: per tile: count over 200 ms and the maximum

validity: whole-window D12 with the VM rule: start load 4 or less, no outside process over 0.5 core, harness CPUs 5-7 under 95% mean busy, steal on CPUs 0-4 at most 1% each, policy restored
on_failure: keep the row, diagnose from evidence and report. No rerun without a stated reason. A collection-only fault may get one explicitly named retry, e32-soak-r1-a1. A cluster failure may not.
